item.title: Vodafone Fiji Bulikula final 23-member squad named
item.description: The backline features Leilani Ahsam, Teaghan Hartigan, Talei Holmes, Tamika Jones, Ebony Laing, Sienna Laing and Lorren Ieli. The forwards are Losana Lutu, Tahlia Marshall, Ema Masi, Rory Muller, Sereana Naitokatoka and Tanina Naividi.
item.content:encoded:
The backline features Leilani Ahsam, Teaghan Hartigan, Talei Holmes, Tamika Jones, Ebony Laing, Sienna Laing and Lorren Ieli.

The forwards are Losana Lutu, Tahlia Marshall, Ema Masi, Rory Muller, Sereana Naitokatoka and Tanina Naividi.

The reserves are Elizabeth Naleba, Aliti Namoce, Maria Paseka, Abigayle Sekitoga, Latisha Smythe, Cassie Staples, Naomi Tegu, Nanise Vakacavu, Isabella Waterman and Luisa Yaranamua.

The Bulikula will open their campaign against New Zealand next Sunday at 2.15pm in Newcastle.

They will then face Papua New Guinea on the 24th of this month in Port Moresby, before their final match against France on the 31st at Gold Coast.

Messi scores in final Argentina appearance as legendary international career ends
item.description: The 39-year-old converted a second-half penalty to score his 126th international goal in his 208th and final appearance for Argentina. Messi also provided the assists for Nicolas Otamendi and Nico Paz as Argentina completed a comfortable victory at the Monumental Stadium.
item.content:encoded:
The 39-year-old converted a second-half penalty to score his 126th international goal in his 208th and final appearance for Argentina.

Messi also provided the assists for Nicolas Otamendi and Nico Paz as Argentina completed a comfortable victory at the Monumental Stadium.

More than 85,000 fans packed the stadium for Messi's farewell, with the Argentinian captain visibly emotional during the national anthem before kick-off.

A giant Argentina number 10 shirt carrying a thank-you message for Messi was displayed on the field, while the match was also briefly stopped in the 10th minute as supporters gave him a standing ovation.

Messi ends his Argentina career after more than two decades, having won the 2022 FIFA World Cup and the Copa America titles in 2021 and 2024.

He will continue playing at club level with Inter Miami.

item.title: Fiji Bati set to name new captain for Rugby League World Cup next week
item.description: Head coach Mick Potter , who guided the Bati to the semi-finals at the 2017 Rugby League World Cup, says the captain will be named as the team begins preparations at the Uprising Resort in Deuba. With both Kamikamica and Kikau unavailable, Wests Tigers captain and three-time premiership winner Apisai Koroisau is among the likely candidates to lead the side.
item.content:encoded:
Head coach Mick Potter , who guided the Bati to the semi-finals at the 2017 Rugby League World Cup, says the captain will be named as the team begins preparations at the Uprising Resort in Deuba.

With both Kamikamica and Kikau unavailable, Wests Tigers captain and three-time premiership winner Apisai Koroisau is among the likely candidates to lead the side.

Potter is also expected to select a leadership group, with the focus on ensuring the squad works together to produce results.

He says the expectation is for every player to give their best individually and collectively.

The Bati have reached the Rugby League World Cup semi-finals in 2008, 2013 and 2017, losing to Australia on each occasion.
